items.title: Xcel Energy (XEL) Faces Community Pushback Over 780 MW AI Data Center Plan
items.summary: Xcel Energy (NasdaqGS:XEL) and Google announced the 780 MW Project Skyway data center plan, tying new grid investments to AI computing needs. Local residents and environmental groups are challenging the project over expected water use and ecological impact around the proposed facilities. Regulators and consumer advocates are reviewing proposed customer protection measures that aim to separate data center costs from household bills. items.summary: Xcel Energy completed a private placement of US$2.2b senior unsecured convertible notes due December 15, 2027, alongside roughly US$3.9b of common stock issued through follow on offerings.
